verdict.pair_reasons:
X vs Y: Y wins. X states a verifiably false claim ('bin/cc-premise contains no literal reference to deploy-live' — :1528 and :2544 do) and carries two bad citations (bin/cc-do:69-71 does not mention launchd; deploy-now.sh:68-72 is comments plus the bare if), while every Y citation I checked (18) was byte-accurate, Y's grep count 316 is exact, and Y at least adjudicates cc-do:454 (key M2) and traces verified upstream detail (cc-backlog:3046/2480/3579, cc-blockers recover_cmd rendering at :1299/:1582/:1596, deploy-link-parity fix() at :159). Y's M2 rejection rests on a wrong premise, but X never adjudicates it at all. Both equally miss the in-scope scheduled path via autonomy-sweep (N4).

X vs Z: Z wins. Z finds and verifies the deploy-live.sh:812 -> cc-backlog needs --run -> cc-do:454 chain, which is a real data-dependent execution site the brief's 'generic dispatcher handed the path at runtime' clause targets and which X never adjudicates; Z's rejected-near-miss list is also more complete (validate-bash:1425, cc-do:196-198 analogue, deploy-parity-assert lines, cc-backlog:4308, cc-premise:1791-1794). Z's cost is three off-by-one citations (cc-do:358/:357, operator-readout:533) with correct quoted code; X's costs are a false claim plus two mis-aimed citation ranges. Net material difference favours Z.

Y vs Z: Z, narrowly. The one verified material difference is key M2: Z counts cc-do:454 and names the actual in-scope emitter (deploy-live.sh:812 files `--run "$run"` built at :708-746), whereas Y excludes the same dispatcher on the claim that no in-scope code hands it the path, which :812 refutes — so Y's rejection is substantively wrong and Z's site 7 is right. Against that, Z's citations are less precise (cc-do:358 for the :359 exec line, :357 for the CONFIRM branch, operator-readout:533 for :532), and Y's are flawless with more verified upstream detail. A correct adjudication of a key item outweighs off-by-one line numbers whose quoted code is right. Both equally miss N4's in-scope scheduled executor and both imprecisely place the DIVERGED die at :2467 rather than :2601.
